ValidationRule.description: Enforces the Re-Issue and Lost/Damaged record types at the API level. Record-type picklist subsetting is a UI-only constraint, so only a validation rule actually prevents an integration or Data Loader insert from skipping the previous passport number.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Draft")), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Re_Issue", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Lost_Damaged" ), ISBLANK(Previous_Passport_No__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter the Previous Passport Number before submitting a Re-Issue or Lost/Damaged application.
